# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 11 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** PSO 11 | **Agents:** EMET / LOGOS / PNEUMA / SOPHIA

---

**Total disagreements:** 4

**1. 11:1**
All four agents agree on 'Sound in Zion the trumpet of the sanctuary' — this line is distinctive and important. PNEUMA adds exclamation to every line for greater energy.

**2. 11:5**
EMET: 'He leveled the high mountains into flat land.' LOGOS: 'He has leveled great mountains to a plain.' PNEUMA: 'He has leveled the mountains to flat ground.' Minor variation.

**3. 11:7**
EMET: 'Put on your glorious garments.' LOGOS: 'Put on your robes of glory.' PNEUMA: 'Dress yourself in your glory.' All render the same image differently.

**4. 11:9**
EMET: 'Let the LORD do what he has spoken over Israel.' LOGOS/SOPHIA: 'May the LORD perform what he has promised.' PNEUMA: 'Let the LORD do everything he has spoken.' The prayer-form (optative) consistent across all.
